{"hypotheses": [
{
"name":"Hypothesis 1",
"mechanism":"Companies with high R&D investment (RD) and high advertising expense (AdExp) tend to have better growth prospects due to investment in innovation and brand equity building, especially in an expanding market (MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"RD"},{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"AdExp"}],
"regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"large","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"RD","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.6,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":60},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 2",
"mechanism":"Companies with high asset growth (AssetGrowth) and low leverage (Leverage) are more likely to perform well in a market downturn (MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN) due to their expanding asset base and low debt.",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"AssetGrowth"},{"weight":-1.0,"primitive":"Leverage"}],
"regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"large","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"Leverage","bound":"below","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.7,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":70},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 3",
"mechanism":"Companies that exhibit high idiosyncratic risk (IdioVolAHT) and short-term reversal (STreversal) tendencies are expected to underperform, especially in a high volatility market regime (VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":-0.5,"primitive":"IdioVolAHT"},{"weight":-0.5,"primitive":"STreversal"}],
"regime":"VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN","direction":"lower"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"small","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"IdioVolAHT","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.5,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":50},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 4",
"mechanism":"Firms with high operating profitability (OperProf) and low illiquidity (Illiquidity) are expected to outperform, especially during low volatility market conditions (VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"OperProf"},{"weight":-1.0,"primitive":"Illiquidity"}],
"regime":"VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"large","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"OperProf","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.65,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":65},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 5",
"mechanism":"Companies with high sales growth over inventory growth (GrSaleToGrInv) and low change in net noncurrent operating assets (ChNNCOA) should perform better, especially during periods of positive term spread (TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"GrSaleToGrInv"},{"weight":-1.0,"primitive":"ChNNCOA"}],
"regime":"TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"large","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"GrSaleToGrInv","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.55,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":55},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 6",
"mechanism":"Firms with high earnings consistency (EarningsConsistency) and low short interest (ShortInterest) are expected to outperform, especially during periods of negative term spread (TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"EarningsConsistency"},{"weight":-1.0,"primitive":"ShortInterest"}],
"regime":"TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"mega","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"EarningsConsistency","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.6,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":60},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 7",
"mechanism":"Companies with high change in taxes (ChTax) and low intangible return using sale to price (IntanSP) are expected to underperform, especially during periods of market upturn (MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":-0.5,"primitive":"ChTax"},{"weight":-0.5,"primitive":"IntanSP"}],
"regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP","direction":"lower"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"small","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"ChTax","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.55,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":55},
{
"name":"Hypothesis 8",
"mechanism":"Companies with high total accruals (TotalAccruals) and low book leverage (BookLeverage) are expected to perform better, especially during periods of market downturn (MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN).",
"expression":{
"terms":[{"weight":1.0,"primitive":"TotalAccruals"},{"weight":-1.0,"primitive":"BookLeverage"}],
"regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN",
"vol_target":true},
"auxiliary_predictions":[
{"type":"regime_interaction","regime":"MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN","direction":"higher"},
{"type":"size_segment","segment":"micro","direction":"stronger"},
{"type":"correlation","primitive":"TotalAccruals","bound":"above","threshold":0.3}],
"expected_annualized_sharpe":0.5,
"expected_decay_half_life_months":50}
]}
